My experience with this builder and their marketing team has been nothing short of a nightmare. I paid ₹51,000 under their so-called “spot offer” after they confidently promised an immediate refund if I cancelled the same day. I cancelled on the same day itself — and it has now been over 2 months with no refund.

The behaviour of the marketing team has been completely misleading, unprofessional, and full of false assurances. Every promise they made during booking was conveniently forgotten the moment I asked for my refund.

Later I found out that Origin Group is connected to the old Ravi Group, which had several customer issues in their Mira Road projects as well. This raised even more red flags for me.

Most of the positive reviews online look completely manufactured and not from genuine buyers. My experience was the exact opposite of those fake reviews.

This is my strong warning to anyone thinking of booking here: please be extremely cautious. Get everything in writing. Do not trust verbal commitments. Based on what I faced, I would strongly advise people to think 10 times before putting their hard-earned money here.
